summary: Frontend-only testing of new features: Menu bar, Categories page, Related products, and Editable footer. ALL 14 FEATURES TESTED AND WORKING CORRECTLY. App runs in MOCK MODE with all APIs intercepted by mockAdapter.js.
passed_tests: Menu bar on storefront shows all 5 navigation links (Trang chủ, Cửa hàng, Danh mục sản phẩm, Bài viết, Liên hệ) on desktop
Mobile hamburger menu toggle works and shows mobile dropdown with all 5 navigation links
Categories link in menu navigates to /shop/the-elite-shop/categories
Category page shows all 6 categories with product counts (Electronics: 11, Fashion: 8, Home & Garden: 7, Kitchen: 6, Beauty & Health: 5, Sports & Outdoors: 5)
Category page shows product cards for each category (up to 5 per category)
Category page Load More button links to storefront with category filter (?category=cat-1)
Product detail view shows Related Products section with products from same category
Related Products section shows up to 4 products from the same category
Clicking a related product switches to that product's detail view
4-column editable footer renders on storefront with correct column titles (About Us, Customer Service, Quick Links, Follow Us)
Footer settings in dashboard Layout tab allows editing column titles and content
Footer settings allows removing columns (tested removing column 3)
Footer settings allows adding columns back (Add Column button appears when <4 columns)
Saving footer settings persists changes (success toast: 'Chân trang đã được cập nhật')
Search input works in header (filtered products when searching 'headphones')
Cart button functions in header (opens cart drawer with items)
Dashboard button visible for logged-in shop owners on storefront
critical_code_review_comments: All new features implemented correctly and working as expected
Menu bar uses proper data-testid attributes for testing
Footer columns use dynamic grid layout based on column count
Related products correctly filter by category_id
Category page properly links to storefront with category filter parameter
seed_data_creation: None - using existing mock data from mockData.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (menu bar, categories page, related products, editable footer) are working correctly. Previous iteration (14) had a CRITICAL bug with ReactQuill WYSIWYG editor crashing due to React 19 incompatibility - this was NOT tested in this iteration as it was not in scope. The app runs in MOCK MODE with all APIs intercepted by mockAdapter.js.

mocked_api.note: Mock mode is intentional for standalone frontend development/demo

menu_bar.desktop: 5 navigation links visible (Home, Shop, Categories, Blog, Contact)
menu_bar.mobile: Hamburger toggle opens dropdown with all 5 links

related_products.location: Product detail view, below main product info
related_products.count: Up to 4 products from same category
related_products.navigation: Clicking switches to that product's detail view

editable_footer.operations: Edit title/content, remove column, add column (max 4), save
